item.title: Rodeo champion Kelsie Domer’s 3 year old daughter Oaklynn dies after tragic horse accident during medical episode
item.description: Rodeo champion Kelsie Domer’s 3 year old daughter Oaklynn died on February 19 after a horse suffered a medical episode and fell on them. Kelsie survived but Oaklynn did not. The news was shared through an obituary and reported by Rodeo Life. The rodeo community honored Oaklynn by wearing pink and sharing heartfelt tributes.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Is the 2026 FIFA World Cup schedule at risk? FIFA addresses relocation fears amid rising security concerns
item.description: Security concerns in parts of Mexico have raised questions about whether 2026 FIFA World Cup matches could be relocated. FIFA says it is closely monitoring the situation with authorities and prioritizes safety. Officials stress that moving games would be a last resort, and the tournament across the United States, Canada, and Mexico remains scheduled as planned.
item.dc:creator: Barsha Dutta

item.title: Jake Paul’s fiance Jutta Leerdam earns royal honour at Huis ten Bosch Palace after record breaking Olympic win
item.description: Jutta Leerdam won gold in the 1,000m and silver in the 500m at the Milano Cortina Winter Olympics. After her success, she was named a Knight of the Order of Orange-Nassau by the Dutch royal family. The ceremony took place at Huis ten Bosch Palace. Jake Paul celebrated proudly as fans praised her achievements online.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Antonela Roccuzzo Net Worth in 2026: Inside Lionel Messi’s wife’s rise from Rosario to global influencer
item.description: Antonela Roccuzzo, Lionel Messi’s wife, has built an estimated $20 million net worth through modeling, brand partnerships, and social media influence. Born in Rosario, she grew from a private figure into a global lifestyle icon. With major fashion collaborations, philanthropic work, and over 40 million followers, she balances family life with business success and international recognition.
item.dc:creator: Barsha Dutta

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez combined net worth in 2026: Football player and model wife among richest couples with $1.4 billion fortune
item.description: Football superstar Cristiano Ronaldo and his partner Georgina Rodriguez are among the world's richest athletes. By 2026, Ronaldo's wealth is projected to be around $1.4 billion from his Al Nassr contract, Nike deal, and businesses. Georgina's net worth is estimated at $10 million from modeling and her Netflix series. Together, their combined wealth is substantial.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Alysa Liu reveals emotional post-Olympic life plan after gold, hints at unexpected future beyond competitive figure skating
item.description: Alysa Liu captured Olympic gold at the 2026 Milano Cortina Games with a powerful free skate, becoming the first American woman in years to reach that milestone. Her victory, along with team gold, marked a major moment for U.S. figure skating. Now, Liu is looking beyond medals, sharing her interest in fashion, storytelling, and creative expression. Her Olympic moment has become both an athletic triumph and the start of a broader personal journey.
item.dc:creator: Prantik Prabal Roy

item.title: LA Knight and Michelle Yavulla combined net worth in 2026: WWE salary, brand value, and financial success story
item.description: WWE's LA Knight, real name Shaun Ricker, is a rising star with impressive mic skills and charisma. His career success, boosted by a new contract and merchandise sales, is reflected in his growing net worth. Knight's financial success, alongside his wife Michelle Yavulla, is projected to reach $4-10 million by early 2026, showcasing their strong presence in sports entertainment.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Why MLB added the ABS challenge system? Disputed fourth pitch in Spring Training shows its importance
item.description: Major League Baseball introduced an automated ball-and-strike (ABS) challenge system to improve fairness and consistency in officiating. This hybrid approach allows players to challenge calls, aiming to reduce prolonged arguments and keep the game moving. Influenced by minor league tests and a recent Spring Training dispute, the system preserves umpire judgment while leveraging technology for accuracy.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Fact check: Did Megyn Kelly help Candace Owens produce “Bride of Charlie” trailer about Erika Kirk and Charlie Kirk?
item.description: After backlash followed the trailer release, Megyn Kelly publicly responded to claims about her involvement. She focused on the exact language used by Candace Owens and denied that a direct murder accusation was made against Erika Kirk. Kelly’s comments, shared on her SiriusXM program, have added fresh attention to the ongoing public debate.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Abandoned and decaying: What’s left inside Jeffrey Epstein’s ‘Lolita Express’ after years grounded?
item.description: For nearly a decade, Jeffrey Epstein’s former Boeing 727 has sat abandoned in Georgia, engines stripped and interior decaying. Once used to ferry powerful figures and, prosecutors say, trafficking victims between his properties, the jet remains a haunting relic of his crimes. Despite ownership changes and scrapping plans, it endures as a physical symbol of scandal and unanswered questions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: The Bride Of Charlie: Candace Owens sparks rift with Erika Kirk exposé; only Matt Walsh speaks out
item.description: Candace Owens has stirred major controversy after releasing the trailer for her YouTube investigative series The Bride of Charlie, centered on Erika Kirk. The preview quickly went viral, prompting backlash, intense online debate, and questions directed at Charlie Kirk’s allies. While supporters call it accountability journalism, critics warn it risks harassment and speculation, as silence from prominent conservative voices fuels growing tension.
item.dc:creator: Barsha Dutta

item.title: The unconscious soundtrack of the doomscroll generation? It's phonk
Russian agency claims UK, France covertly planning to transfer N-weapons to Ukraine
item.description: Russia's intelligence agency alleges Britain and France are secretly planning to supply nuclear weapons to Ukraine, a claim vehemently denied by Kyiv and France as "an outright lie" and "absurd." Moscow stated this information is crucial for ongoing peace talks, while Ukraine urged the international community to reject Russia's "dirty information bombs."

item.title: BoJo says send non-combat European troops to Ukraine now
item.description: Former UK PM Boris Johnson urged Europe to deploy non-combat troops to Ukraine immediately, criticizing the continent's insufficient pressure on Russia. He argued that such a move would demonstrate commitment and push Putin towards negotiations. Johnson also highlighted Europe's continued energy imports from Russia, calling for increased urgency to secure Ukraine's victory at a lower cost.

item.title: Kick Streamer Cheesur deletes YTG X Community after viral El Mencho rumor links him to Mexican military intel claim
item.description: Kick streamer Nermin “Cheesur” deleted his X Community after a viral post claimed he helped Mexican forces target El Mencho. The post reached 3.2 million views before being removed. Cheesur denied the rumor during a livestream and said fans had turned on him. Cameron “Cuffem” also defended him, calling the backlash toxic and harmful.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: CaseOh caught off guard as massive fan-made plush takes over his stream
item.description: Streamer CaseOh went viral after unwrapping a seven-foot crocheted plush made in his likeness by Clovis creator Christian, known as “The Crochet Ginger.” The handmade doll was revealed during a livestream and quickly gained attention online. With over 1.1 million TikTok followers, the crochet artist’s detailed creation impressed fans and sparked widespread social media reactions.
